login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue to {{product}}.
login.unavailable: The console is not reachable. Check that the backend is running.
login.firstUserHint: No accounts exist yet. The first one you create becomes the administrator.
login.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

banner.noAuthBody: Every visitor has full administrator rights. Never use AUTH_MODE=none outside local development.
banner.readOnlyBody: This console cannot modify anything on the connected clusters.

clusters.noneHelp: Add a cluster to config/clusters.yaml, or create one in Settings.

errors.genericBody: The request failed. This is usually temporary.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist.
errors.forbiddenBody: Your role does not allow this action.

empty.comingSoonBody: This page arrives in a later milestone.

overview.capabilitiesHint: Detected when connecting. Features this broker does not support are hidden or disabled.

topics.name: Topic
topics.rfOneHint: Replication factor 1: losing one broker loses this topic's data.
topics.noneHelp: This cluster has no non-internal topics yet.

topicDetail.noGroupsHelp: No group has committed offsets for this topic.
topicDetail.notFoundHelp: It may have been deleted since the list was loaded.

groups.noneHelp: Nothing has consumed from this cluster yet.
groups.noOffsetsHelp: This group has not committed any offsets yet.
groups.noMembersHelp: The group is inactive. Offsets can be reset safely in this state.

replication.subtitle: Replica placement and health, from broker metadata. No JMX required.
replication.atMinIsrHint: In-sync replicas have fallen to min.insync.replicas. One more failure stops producers using acks=all.
replication.brokerBalanceHint: Uneven leader counts concentrate client traffic on a few brokers.
replication.allHealthyHelp: Every partition has a leader and a full in-sync replica set.

messages.selectTopicHelp: Pick a topic above, then search or start a live tail.
messages.maskedHint: Sensitive values were masked before leaving the server.
messages.noResultsHelp: Try a wider time range, a different start point, or a simpler filter.

metrics.subtitle: From the built-in offset sampler. No Prometheus or JMX required.
metrics.lagChartLabel: Consumer lag over time with consume and produce rates
metrics.heatmapHint: Darker cells are busier. Uneven rows mean partition skew; a single dark cell is a hot partition.
metrics.noSamplesHelp: The sampler runs every {{seconds}} seconds. Charts appear once it has collected at least two readings.
metrics.samplerOffBody: Lag history, throughput and the heatmap need it. Set SAMPLER_ENABLED=true to turn it back on.

audit.subtitle: Every write is recorded, including refusals.
audit.noneHelp: Nothing has been changed in this period.
audit.adminOnly: Only administrators can read the audit log, because before/after snapshots can reveal cluster structure.

settings.configHint: These come from the environment. Change them in .env and restart.
settings.passwordRule: At least 12 characters, and at most 72 bytes when UTF-8 encoded.
settings.deleteUserBody: {{username}} will lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.

reset.title: Reset consumer group offsets
reset.explainer: Skipped messages are never processed. Replayed messages are delivered a second time; make sure the consumer can handle duplicates.
reset.confirmBody: {{skipped}} messages will be skipped and {{replayed}} replayed. This cannot be undone.

alerts.subtitle: Rules are evaluated against the built-in sampler, so alerting needs no Prometheus either.
alerts.forSecondsHint: The condition must hold continuously for this long before the rule fires, so a single noisy sample does not page anyone.
alerts.noRulesHelp: Create one to be told when lag grows, partitions go offline, or a broker disappears.
alerts.quietHelp: No alert rule has changed state in this period.
alerts.noSinksBody: Rules still fire and appear here. To be told elsewhere, set WEBHOOK_URL, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL or SMTP_HOST in .env.
alerts.readOnlyNote: Alert rules can still be managed; read-only only blocks changes to your Kafka clusters.
alerts.deleteRuleBody: {{name}} will stop being evaluated. Its firing history is kept.

dashboards.subtitle: Build your own panels over any topic. Anything specific to your pipeline lives here, not in the product.
dashboards.importFailed: That file is not a valid dashboard export.
dashboards.name: Dashboard name
dashboards.onDemandHint: Rendering runs a bounded scan, so it happens on demand rather than on a timer.
dashboards.noneHelp: Create one to chart throughput, split by any field, histogram a numeric value, or show a top-N table.
dashboards.deleteBody: {{name}} and its panel definitions will be removed. Export it first if you want to keep it.

flow.subtitle: How data moves through this cluster. Measured edges are marked apart from declared ones.
flow.declaredHint: From producer_hints in clusters.yaml, not measured.
flow.noProducers: None declared. Kafka cannot report these.
flow.emptyHelp: This cluster has no topics, or the sampler has not collected anything.
flow.tracerSubtitle: Match records between two topics by key and measure the time between them.
flow.unmatchedHint: Target records whose key was not seen on the source side within the scanned window.
flow.negativeHint: The target record predates its source. Usually a clock skew or a wrong join key.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Jump to a page, topic, group or cluster…

schemas.subtitle: Browse subjects and versions, and diff any two.
schemas.noSubjectsHelp: Nothing has registered a schema in this registry yet.

acls.subtitle: Access control entries on this cluster.
acls.noneHelp: This cluster has an authorizer but no entries yet.
acls.notAvailable: ACLs are not available on this cluster

addCluster.title: Add a cluster
addCluster.name: Name
addCluster.readOnly: Read-only (blocks every write, even for admins)
addCluster.noneBody: Add one below to start browsing topics, or set KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS and restart.
